verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a Gmail-based email client with team features, so asking whether it handles customer SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat alongside email is a fair question. The evidence shows no such channels. The AI integrations with Slack and other apps, and the internal Workspaces/chat mentioned by a community user, are adjacent features, not customer channels in the inbox.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
